purpose: City-specific discovery of official cadastral parcel geometry for Turkestan, Kazakhstan; failed access and source-search outcomes are not treated as evidence that no cadastre exists.
name: Turkestan

queries.query: Turkistan Kazakhstan official cadastral parcel map GIS cadastre land registry
queries.result: Found the official Turkestan Region geoportal, the national AIS GZK cadastral viewer, the newer EGKN public cadastral-map reference, and a Turkestan local land-relations authority. No safe anonymous parcel polygon response was verified.

queries.query: Түркістан кадастр картасы жер учаскесі ресми карта; Туркестан кадастровая карта земельный участок официальный карта
queries.result: Kazakh/Russian discovery returned the official Turkestan Region geoportal, a Turkestan city notice describing the transition from the Geoportal to the EGKN automated workplace for land-rights services, and the national AIS GZK viewer. No anonymous city parcel polygon was verified.

officialSources.observation: Official Turkestan Region geoportal identified in discovery; its public page presents regional maps and administrative/place layers, but no safely bounded parcel polygon response was extracted.

Official AIS GZK viewer identifies the state land-cadastre department context and public cadastral-map functions. Its current JavaScript configuration exposes ArcGIS proxy route names including aisgzkZem2/MapServer for land parcels.
Official Turkestan Region land-relations authority page; this is the local/regional custodian context, not proof of an open parcel API.
Official Turkestan city notice says land-relations services moved from the Geoportal to the EGKN automated workplace under the newer procedure; it does not publish anonymous parcel geometry.
Official government reference points to the public cadastral map at https://map.gov4c.kz/egkn/.

requests.outcome: Empty reply from server in this environment; no login or bypass attempted and no schema/geometry retained.
Viewer HTML and JavaScript were retrieved. Configuration exposed parcel route candidate /aisgzk/Proxy/aisgzkZem2/MapServer; this is route/config evidence only.
Proxy route returned Not Found; no service schema, CRS, fields, ID+geometry response, or polygon was obtained.

requests.method: GET anonymous ArcGIS layer metadata probe
requests.outcome: Proxy route returned Not Found; no layer schema or geometry was obtained.

registryBasis: Official Turkestan Region geoportal and official regional land-relations authority are evidenced, and the national AIS GZK viewer is a public cadastral-map service. This does not establish a usable anonymous city parcel geometry endpoint.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Turkestan Region geoportal, national AIS GZK cadastral viewer, and EGKN public-map reference.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No anonymous Turkestan-bounded parcel polygon response, schema, CRS, or stable safe native parcel identity was verified.

remainingUncertainty: The regional and national systems may contain parcel data, but the local viewer was unreachable, the configured AIS GZK parcel proxy returned 404, the EGKN host had an unverified certificate, and the digital-land portal timed out. No exact-point hit or access failure is treated as citywide absence; the WUP point was preserved exactly without shifting it.
